svg.title: Proof of work — security, docs, ownership
svg.desc: Proof of work, part 2. Real-time — login anomaly detection. IP capture, risk scoring and an email alert to the account owner on every suspicious event. Docs — site with full user documentation. docs.dualmindlab.tech. E2E — design to code to infra to deploy to docs. From first commit to a monitored production system.
